name: Council's Judgment
oracle_text: Will of the council — Starting with you, each player votes for a nonland permanent you don't control. Exile each permanent with the most votes or tied for most votes.
blocked_sentences: Will of the council — Starting with you, each player votes for a nonland permanent you don't control. Exile each permanent with the most votes or tied for most votes.

needs.what: a vote op (rule 701.38): starting with the spell's controller and going in turn order, each player chooses one object from a selector (here nonland permanents the controller doesn't control) as a vote, without targeting; the tally is kept per candidate, and the op binds 'each candidate with the most votes or tied for most' under an `as` so a following effect (exile) can act on that set
needs.why_existing_wont_do: for_each_player with starting_with can walk the players, but choose_permanents has no per-player chooser (only as/max_total_power/objects/prompt) and no value key counts how many players chose a given object, so neither the per-player vote nor the 'most votes or tied' tally can be said; targeting would be wrong because Council's Judgment does not target (it beats hexproof/shroud)
